quotes.title: WASP-6
quotes.card: WASP-6, also officially named Márohu, is a type-G yellow dwarf star located about 651 light-years away in the Aquarius constellation.
quotes.introduction: Dim at magnitude 12, it is visible through a moderate sized amateur telescope.
